chapter: Gulf Coast and later working bands
title: Making Henry Newfield leader at the Court of the Two Sisters
summary: As Joe Fine's music advisor, Hirsch had Henry Newfield form the band, with Pat on bass, until Fine let the pianist go.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah, he was with, Pat was with me for ages. In fact, I got, I got, I made Henry Newfield a leader at the Court of the Two Sisters. Joe Fine is a very dear friend of mine. I've known Joe all my life almost. And I was his music advisor down at the, at the, at the Court of the Two Sisters. Uh-huh. And, uh, he needed a band. So I asked Henry if he wanted to work on it. And he got, he got that little, the barber, the piano player. And, uh, he had Pat on bass. He was, I don't remember who played trumpet with him. But, uh, they started playing down there at the Court of the Two Sisters. And they built up quite a, quite a, quite a business.
What did you call him, uh, that plays piano? From across the river? Valentino, Valentino.
Valentino. You know him, uh, Valentino's his name. And, uh, he was down there with them. And, uh, after about three years, they were doing terrific business. Joe comes up and fires him.
